prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Caldera Wildfire Detection and Suppression Support System advises only; incident command retains authority; no autonomous dispatch/control. Actors: Duty Detection Officer=Orion; Air Attack Supervisor=Redtail; County Emergency Liaison; Tanker Base Manager; Helitack Crew Leader; Drone Pilot Operator; fire/emergency/aviation/public-safety partners. Records require full names, timestamps/identities/radio-path status; mandatory segmentation/time-sync/health/audits and source/model/georeference/status/acknowledgement traceability. Caldera Incident Command Portal=Emberhall holds decisions/constraints/restrictions/searchable dismissals (no assignments/notifications), displays crew acknowledgements beside aviation tasks. Confirmed Ignition State with delayed approval preserves planning, blocks premature dispatch; Airspace Restricted State requires authority acceptance. Horizon Ridge Drone Dock=Kestrel supports launch/recovery/charging/shelter; maintenance controller produces threshold-triggered Battery Swap Ticket; pilot uses it for endurance/return planning. Sentinel Fireline Analytics Engine=Lantern normalizes imagery/weather, produces traceable assessments/advice, may down-weight degraded Smoke Classifier Module. MesoWest Weather Fusion Node=Brindle supplies quality-checked weather/routing context and rule-triggered Wind Shift Bulletin. Talon Air Tanker Dispatch Console=Marigold supplies lanes/status/aircraft/loading/mission data to supervisor/base manager. VHF Radio Gateway Repeater=Badger bridges command/aviation/county communications, preserves available speaker identity, broadband-loss continuity, controlled recordings; failures require portal impairment marking and Orion acknowledgement/alternate-contact verification before new aviation messages. North Lookout Camera Mast sends Thermal Spot Snippet and timestamped bearing/pan/tilt/zoom/confidence; South Lookout Camera Mast supplies triangulation bearing and Camera Cleaning Log. Classifier supplies smoke likelihood/growth/obscuration/confidence/Ridge Shadow Mask; Orion reviews before queue acceptance. Crewline Mobile Tablet delivers released context; crew leader acknowledges instructions/reports drop/reconnaissance occupancy; supervisor verifies clearance. East Retardant Loading Pump produces Retardant Batch Slip; manager coordinates West Retardant Loading Pump readiness/aircraft sequencing. Liaison sends Drone Corridor Permit; portal records constraints. Drone Tasking Service lacks release authority, shall avoid aviation lanes, packages approved footprints/altitudes/revisits. Supervisor deconflicts/checks restrictions/perimeter; pilot reviews safety. Assessment correlates geometry/terrain/fuels/resources; permitted drone frames undergo orthorectification/grid-registration before

New part:
S112: Analytic results are not displayed as final fireline until confidence thresholds, sensor age, and positional error are applied as explicit map attributes.
S113: The MesoWest Weather Fusion Node ingests station observations, forecast grids, and local quality checks to maintain the wind, humidity, temperature, and stability fields used by the spread model.
S114: Brindle publishes a time-indexed weather update that marks significant forecast changes and identifies which map products require recomputation.
S115: Weather fields are interpolated across the incident area with terrain-aware weighting so ridge, drainage, and slope effects are represented at operational map scale.
S116: Geospatial overlays include fuels, slope, aspect, roads, structures, water sources, jurisdiction boundaries, evacuation zones, and known communications coverage.
S117: The fire behavior model combines the accepted perimeter, recent growth vectors, weather fields, and fuel conditions to estimate short-term spread direction and rate.
S118: Model output is expressed as probability bands rather than a single line so supervisors can see both the most likely path and the practical planning margin.
S119: Emberhall renders the current perimeter, projected spread, resource positions, and decision annotations into a common operating picture with role-based symbology.
S120: The Caldera Incident Command Portal produces the Crew Staging Pin from the approved map layer and assigns it an effective time, location accuracy, and incident identifier.
S121: Operational recommendations are generated from rule checks that compare projected fire arrival times with values at risk, road access, crew travel time, and aircraft availability.
S122: Recommendations may include confirming an ignition, increasing camera monitoring, requesting drone coverage, preparing aviation options, repositioning ground crews, or notifying county partners.
S123: The Air Attack Supervisor receives map products that emphasize projected columns, flight hazards, target areas, and timing constraints without obscuring ground resource information.
S124: The County Emergency Liaison receives a simplified view that preserves perimeter confidence, threatened areas, and recommended public safety coordination actions while hiding tactical details not needed for civil coordination.
S125: Every map product records source time, processing time, model version, analyst acceptance, and supersession status so users can distinguish current guidance from archived assessments.
S126: When inputs conflict, the common operating picture shows the conflict explicitly and requires review before the affected recommendation is promoted for command use.
S127: Suppression planning begins after the Caldera Incident Command Portal promotes an accepted fire location into the operational map and marks it available for aviation review.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
